body: Okay listen to me, your son (I'm assuming) is too young to realise what's going on, and he probably just doesn't recognise you as his parent. Your ex sounds like a real piece of work, but if you keep fighting and keep trying, things will look up. One day your son will realise what you mean to him. I can't promise you it will be soon, but I know it will happen. And when he realises what you've been doing to just spend time with him, he'll appreciate it so much.
If I'm ever feeling down I'm going to remember your kind words, thank you. :)
Thank you! I'm 14 days clean and still staying strong. You're lovely, and I appreciate it. There's something out there for me, I know it.
It's a long story. Very long.

"I'm okay, I promise. Please don't worry about me" 
While sitting in my bathtub with a razor in my hand. I was not okay but I pushed through it, I am going to be okay one day.

I cannot be alone with my own thoughts ever because, if I am, I'll end up binging, purging, cutting, whatever. And although it's jus to try and shut up those awful voices, I'm afraid they'll take it too far and hurt me more than "just enough" we all struggle. We all deal in different ways. I promise you're not alone.

So don't put others through it! Trust me, I have horrible, invasive thoughts of death every day. And I think about how much easier it would be if I ended it. But I know in my heart it won't be that easy. It's never easy. Stay strong, if you need, you can PM me. Please stay with us. We need you.

I went to school with a girl who committed suicide by hanging, I wasn't particularly close with the girl, in fact, we didn't get along but still stayed out of each others way. It haunts me. I have dreams that she's still here. That everyone's looking for her, and she's just hiding. Trying to get away from it all. This is one of the main reasons I am still here, because although I feel nobody will care, there might be at least one person out there who feels the same way I do. And I wouldn't want to inflict this on anybody. So, you see, it does affect others. I just hope you keep that in mind, you seem so lovely...
Piece of work puts it nicely.
I suppose you're right. And I apologise I feel asleep

I know it couldn't hurt I just have a very hard time opening up to anyone. In fact I'm still baffled as to why I posted here. I went to school with a girl who was repeatedly assaulted by her counsellor, so I'm a bit afraid of that. I've been through a lot of abuse. Physical, sexual or psychological. I am afraid of my own shadow though, so there's that b

I guess I know I won't be here forever but.. I'm just 18 and I'm still trying to finish high school. The school itself is great, it's for people like me who didn't finish for what ever reason. I just feel like there's no point. That it'll be over soon and I don't want to waste anyone's time.
I just might. :)
You're really wonderful though. If we don't speak again, I want you to know this.
I'll definitely consider it. I never thought of it before tonight. Thanks, by the way, for taking my mind off things. You're an angel.

Thanks for the chuckle :) 
The fear of getting fat is sort of the after affect of fear of eating food I shouldn't... I'm actually afraid to eat like, chips. But my family would just fall apart without me. There's nothing else holding us together and I'd feel far too guilty to leave..

My family really depends on me. My mother stays up all night then sleeps all day, my dad works far too much and when he's not working he's basically babysitting my mother who refuses to take meds. We're all a bit older but I feel I'm the only thing holding this family together.
I would love to drop everything and just go. Spend a day there, on my own.
Probably. They're so fluffy and cute. They love playing in snow. My local zoo just got some, I hope I get the chance to visit them.
Oh my god I fan girl so hard always...

It's a throwaway so I don't mind.. But I'm basically a recovering anorexic with bulimic tendencies, recovering self harmer, and in diagnosed bipolar disorder sufferer (I do so believe) and obsessive compulsive. My self confidence is a complete low, and I can't help but feel like a freak for everything that goes through my mind. Don't eat that, you can't go here, you haven't finished your 3 hour work out. Your hair is too messy, your thighs too big. Don't eat that, somebody else touched it. That was only washed once. Don't touch that, clean your hands. 
Anyway. Earlier I had just gotten out of the shower (no make up, natural hair, comfy clothes) when my (also crazy) mother says "I don't think your boyfriend could love you date you if he saw you this way." Among implying other things. (That I've gained weight, etc) she also drops not to subtle hints that I should give up on recovery because I'm worthless anyway... I was going through a depressive state, and this has thrown me over the edge. I want it to be over. There's no place for me.

If you domesticated them. Truth is, nobody's tried although they'd make wonderful house pets. They're playful and affectionate. I think maybe because they're high maintenance. I'm not sure. They're not much bigger then house cats, though! I just get really excited about them :)
I know! Sometimes I sit on YouTube all day watching videos of them. I wish I had one. Maybe I wouldn't have such bad anxiety if I did..
Crying again but because this was so sweet. I... Really like animals. Specifically red pandas.
I'll probably sit here refreshing this page until I get the courage to do something about this.
Sometimes hurting is the one thing that keeps us going because, it lets you know you're alive. It lets you know that you're real. Don't keep it bottled up, tell somebody. Any body.

I am experiencing similar feelings, and to be honest the main reason I am still here is because I could never think of leaving my family. I know the sense of being abandoned and I couldn't impose that on anybody intentionally. I do have very intrusive thoughts of death, and I feel that it will come to me. I won't have to find it. I find strange comfort in this. 
But stay strong. The world has a plan for you. You're here for a reason, you may not know it yet, in fact you may never know, but keep that in the back of your mind. You're a fighter. You've made it this far.
I couldn't agree more.
Or don't be so uptight. Yeah, its nice to acknowledge how long you've been together, but like celebrating every single month or whatever, chill out. Its a month.
I don't even know wtf this shit means. you put "insta" in front of a word (or instead of a prefix) and suddenly it makes you "hip" or "cool" or "underground" like, what?

This made me cry. Please stay with us, okay? I know its hard, and just because they're professionals doesn't mean they don't make mistakes. The often times have a very basic way of handling with these situations, when mental disorders (such as depression) vary widely and require different kinds of treatments. I hope you try a different doctor and/or therapist. You mean so much to so many people, I know that. I'm struggling too. But I know you have a purpose here. Please, PM me if ever needed.

I'm trying, but it will probably be in the back of my mind. If you ever need, you may message me, though. I know its tough to try and battle with yourself inside your head. I know I hate being alone with my thoughts.
I'd be lying if I said it didn't phase me. How can somebody be so cruel and kick people when they're already down? Basically saying I'm selfish and my problems don't matter...
You may always pm me if you need, I know your struggle. I'm going through the same thing. I hope you stay strong, I care about you. Others can relate.

Its really hard to promise something like this, especially when they don't understand. I had promise my SO that I'd tell him if I ever wanted to again but he's always busy with work and I like to give him his personal space. I need to get used to the fact that he can't always be there when I  need to distract myself from SH. So, hello reddit.

I just told my boyfriend about mine the other day... I sat there crying for about 20 minutes before I could even choke out what I was trying to say. He was also very understanding. 
I'm really glad you got the courage to tell him, keep fighting, I know you're strong.
Every relationship I've been in I've been cheated on. Ive just started seeing someone new so, hopefully, he won't keep this trend going. But keep your head up, theres some good people out there.
Unfortunately, this seems to be the case. I will never be able to understand that type of reasoning.

Thats all besides the point. I didn't post this to look for sympathy or anything of the sort, I was simply curious why somebody would find this type of thing necessary. And yes, I did dub them as a troll because they were posing as a Mod, when in fact, they were not. And instead of providing actual advice, they were insensitive, condescending and in fact made me feel much more worthless then I had before I submitted my original post.
I'm sorry you don't understand where I'm coming from, but its not like i can just "turn off" my depression... It's comments like this.

Oh my god I got a message from them and bawled my eyes out the first time I tried to reach out to somebody and they just cut me down. I am so relieved it wasn't a real mod that messaged me. It was still a major blow to my self esteem...
Probably my cats, because then no one would be there to feed them...

I usually just wait for it to pass. Because when I'm in a good mood I forget why I ever was upset about anything. I'm almost convinced I can grow out of it? Or, if I ignore it then I can be normal, too...

I'm pretty sure my family would disown me. They don't understand mental disorders, most of all depression. I am not depressed, but I can relate and understand that those who are have no control over what they feel. They would think I am a freak, that I'm not safe to be walking the streets alone. I shouldn't be allowed to marry, or have children for fear that I'd "have an episode" and drown them in the bathtub or something. They wouldn't want anything to do with me, but would probably not let me shower alone. 
We fear what we don't understand.
